name: Paulsgrove Adventure Playground
description: One of Portsmouth's six free, supervised adventure playgrounds, run by PYC Portsmouth for the city council. Open in term time and school holidays; mainly for ages 6 to 13, younger children welcome with an adult. Check opening times with PYC before you go.
